analyst.summary: GHCL is a leading Indian soda ash and salt producer that has largely eliminated its debt and is now diversifying into bromine and vacuum-salt products. FY26 profit was down from prior-year levels amid a global soda-ash pricing downturn, but the June-2026 quarter showed a clear profit recovery (+32% YoY), and the stock trades at a cheap ~9x earnings. We rate it a Hold: a well-capitalized commodity-chemical business showing early signs of a cyclical bottom, at an undemanding valuation.
